title: Building Automation Service Plans — Software Assurance, Version Updates and Security Patch Periods by Tier
content:
# Building Automation Service Plans — Software Assurance, Version Updates and Security Patch Periods by Tier

The software entitlements of the Building Automation Service Plans are set per tier: whether the manufacturer's software assurance is carried under the plan, whether minor version updates are applied at no charge, whether major version upgrades are applied at no charge, the discount on labor for an upgrade the plan does not include, and the number of calendar days within which a published security patch is applied to covered controllers.

| Tier | Software assurance | Minor version updates | Major version upgrades | Upgrade labor discount (percent) | Security patch period (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | not carried | not included | not included | 0 | 90 |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | not carried | not included | not included | 5 | 60 |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | not carried | included | not included | 10 | 45 |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | carried | included | included | 20 | 30 |
| Remote Optimization Plan | carried | included | included | 25 | 21 |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | carried | included | included | 35 | 14 |

Tier distinctions:

- Minor version updates become included from the Scheduled Controls Service Plan upward; major version upgrades and software assurance from the Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan upward.
- The upgrade labor discount is the discount on labor for an upgrade the plan does not include; it rises from 0 percent under the Controls Help Desk Subscription to 35 percent under the Integrated Building Automation Partnership.
- The security patch period is the number of calendar days within which a published patch is applied to covered controllers; it shortens tier by tier from 90 days to 14 days.
